comparison.objective: Set two power-rack safety arms to the correct bench-press height.
comparison.physical_skill: Inferring a safe height and repositioning two indexed supports.
comparison.success_condition: Both arms at 7–8 cm earns full score; unsafe low, uneven, or high arrangements score less or zero.
comparison.reason: Indexed support placement does not require coupled screw-and-nut locking or resisting tightening reaction.
